## ⭐ EDITORIAL NORTH STAR — drives the LEAD of every Lions edit (locked Atdhe 2026-06-29)
> 🔄 **WIDENED 2026-09-18 (Jacqui, 2026-09-08 bi-weekly, fathom-180953179).** Friendship/belonging is no longer the whole target — it is **one dimension among several**, and treating it as the search term is what produced the Painesville sameness twice. Jacqui verbatim: *"it's not just friendships, it's belonging, it's leadership quality, it's this experience more story of like, beyond just the volunteering and the service, what more are you getting from Lions?"* The live target is **the widest set of genuinely different personal stories that each end up at Lions** — family involvement, leadership growth, personal transformation, time-making, owned projects, craft brought in from outside — structured **75% unique story / 25% tie-back** (Qendrim, 2026-09-18). **Batch-specific direction overrides this and must be named on the batch** — Hong Kong stays friendship-first (Atdhe → Qendrim, 2026-09-16, fathom-184461649); Painesville/Australia widen. Governed by `THE UNIQUENESS LEDGER` at the end of this file.
> 🎯 **Goals & Preferences (typo-qa pillar 3) = THIS section** + the On-screen text gates and Standing rules below. Lions' goals live here rather than under a `## 🎯 Goals & Preferences` heading; do NOT create a second goals section — grade pillar 3 against this one. (Pointer added 2026-08-01 by typo-qa after a run nearly duplicated it.)
**Lead every member-story cut with FRIENDSHIP / CAMARADERIE / BELONGING / fellowship — the human draw of Lions membership ("a real big family," "we stay in the clubs through friendship," "we all enjoy together"). Service / impact is the SUPPORT beat, not the headline.** This is the client's stated thesis from Jacqui's 4/16 strategic direction ("lead with friendship & belonging, not service impact") and IS the source of truth for every Lions brief's lead — derive it from THIS profile, not from reactive per-video Frame.io comments.

- ⚖️ **Tactical exception:** honor an explicit per-video client Frame.io note that asks for service on THAT specific piece — but a one-off tactical note NEVER becomes a standing rule that overrides this north star (that's the 5/21→Paris blunder; see Editing-preferences log).
- Program-promo deliverables (e.g. the Cultural Exchange Ambassador piece) are NOT standalone promos — see the Paris exception below (weave the program into the member's personal growth story).
- 🎪 **CONVENTION IS THE SETTING, NEVER THE SUBJECT (added 2026-08-11, Atdhe: Jacqui "doesn't want these to be too convention heavy"; grounded in her 6/2 call — remove lanyards so *"the videos are a little bit more evergreen, as long as they're not standing right in front of a thing that says Hong Kong Convention"*).** Applies to ALL convention-shot content (Hong Kong "Lions of the World", any future convention batch). These cuts must read as EVERGREEN member stories that happen to be told at a convention — not as convention coverage. **Acceptable:** a global-fellowship story WHERE the convention is the vehicle ("I made friends with Lions from all over the world") — that IS the series brief. **Flags (any → `client:` note):** (a) the cut's subject is the convention experience/logistics itself; (b) a home-club story (service projects, club life back home) played over wall-to-wall convention-floor b-roll with "Hong Kong 2026 / 108th Lions International Convention" banners legible — the visuals contradict the evergreen story; (c) sustained legible convention signage/lanyards when an alternative shot exists. Batch-level: across the 32-cut series, audit that the set doesn't aggregate into wall-to-wall convention coverage — mix in tighter framings and people-first b-roll where the selects allow.

### 🇫🇷 PARIS club — STORY-ANGLE EXCEPTION (Jacqui's 5/5/2026 documented direction; refined Atdhe 2026-06-29)
_Like the Skopje per-shoot exception, the Paris club has its OWN documented Jacqui ask — it OVERRIDES the global friendship-lead North Star for every Paris "Traditional" / member-story cut._
**LEAD = LEADERSHIP & GROWTH / PERSONAL BENEFIT.** Jacqui, verbatim 5/5: _"there might be opportunity to talk about leadership and growth within Lions. These are young members organizing a very big, impressive event. How has the Leo and Lion experience equipped them to take on such a project, and how has this benefitted the rest of their personal and professional lives?"_ The HEADLINE is **how the Leo/Lion experience GREW these young members** (equipped them to run a 3,000-runner event) and **what it gave them personally & professionally.**
- **Friendship / camaraderie / belonging = the HUMAN THROUGHLINE** — woven through as a core *personal benefit* of the experience, NOT the hard headline (Atdhe's 6/29 friendship-flip was closer but still not Jacqui's exact ask) and NOT service-led (the old briefs' wrong default). - **Target Audience**: Men and women 18-65, international. Algorithm varies significantly by region:

- Massive global footprint means content needs differ dramatically by region.
